prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1364
Claimant:
Benjamin Ferguson
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
November 10, 2023
First notice of loss came in from the insured's representative, who reported a side impact at a signalized intersection
and a back strain to the claimant, who was the driver of the vehicle struck on the passenger side.
November 13, 2023
Confirmed that the driver is named on the policy and that the policy was in force on the date of loss, with nothing
suggesting the damage happened beofre coverage started.
March 9, 2024
Police report and two statements confirm the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of impact, though no independent
witness has come forward to describe the collision itself and no photographs of the scene have been provided.
April 10, 2024
Reviewed the vehicle file and found no earlier damage recorded on the vehicle, but the repair estimate covers more
panels than the impact area clearly shows, so it is not yet clear whether all of the damage came from this impact.
May 3, 2024
Claimant's representative provided medical records showing a back strain treated with physiotherapy and medication;
the reported injury is plausible for a crash of this type, and no earlier injury to the same body area appears in the
records we hold.
May 4, 2024
Treatment has run somewhat longer than is typical for this injury, so I have asked the treating provider for a note
explaining the continued care before setting any reserve.
May 6, 2024
The claimant has given the same account of the collision in every conversation so far, including the initial call, the
recorded statement and the follow-up with the representative, and the details have not shifted.
June 8, 2024
Nothing independent confirms how the collision happened, so the file remains open pending the provider note and a
review of the damage estimate against the impact pattern.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
